title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Tubudan, Municipality of San Remigio, Province of Antique to Be Known as Governor Evelio B. Javier Memorial National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Tubudan, Municipality of San Remigio, Province of Antique to Be Known as Governor Evelio B. Javier Memorial National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Tubudan, Thị trấn San Remigio, Tỉnh Antique được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Governor Evelio B. Javier Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Tubudan, เทศบาล San Remigio, จังหวัด Antique ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Governor Evelio B. Javier Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Tubudan, Kotamadya San Remigio, Provinsi Antique dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Governor Evelio B. Javier Memorial
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Tubudan, Perbandaran San Remigio, Wilayah Antique dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Governor Evelio B. Javier Memorial

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. - There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Tubudan, Municipality of San Remigio, Province of Antique to be known as Governor Evelio B. Javier Memorial National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Governor Evelio B. Javier Memorial National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
